parts.name: Blade Handle Set (Left)
parts.Basic_description: This part consists of one blade and one handle of the scissors, made of stainless steel for the blade and plastic for the handle.
parts.Functional_description: It provides one cutting edge and one gripping loop for the user to hold and apply force during cutting.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the central screw to open and close against the other blade handle set.

parts.name: Blade Handle Set (Right)
parts.Basic_description: This part includes the second blade and handle, made of stainless steel and plastic, forming the complementary half of the scissors.
parts.Functional_description: It provides the opposing cutting edge and handle loop, working together with the first blade handle set to perform cutting.
parts.Movement_description: It pivots around the screw, moving in opposition to the other blade handle set to create a shearing action.

parts.name: Screw
parts.Basic_description: A small steel screw that connects the two blade handle sets at the pivot point.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the two blade handle sets together and allows them to rotate smoothly around the pivot.
parts.Movement_description: It remains fixed in place, serving as the rotational axis for the two blades.
